scoring_justification: Recompute relative energy from ZPE-corrected electronic energies, check self-consistency, then compare to paper-reported reference values with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold relative energies (kcal/mol) for all nine required species, taken from the paper (Figures 1 and 3 and accompanying text).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values: Fe_CCl4_complex ~ −3, FeCl_CCl3_complex = −19, ClFeCCl3 = −81, FeCl2_plus_CCl2 = −55, Cl2FeCCl2 = −95, Cl3FeCCl = −66, Cl2FeCFeCl2 = −150; Fe and CCl4 are 0 by definition.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read from the paper's energy level diagrams and text; these are the explicit reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers the paper uses in its analysis; they are the target the agent must reproduce.

outputs.description: Table of ZPE-corrected electronic energies and relative energies (vs Fe + CCl4) for all nine required species. The relative energies are recomputed by the checker and compared to hidden reference values from the paper.
